request: Write twenty evaluation cases for our ADK refund agent covering partial refunds, policy exceptions and ambiguous requests, with graders and a judge rubric we can trust.

In the FastAPI app around our ADK agent, GET /api/claims/{claim_id} returns another user's claim if you guess the ID. Fix the route and the shared principal dependency so every claims query filters by the signed-in owner, with tests.
Wire ADK's require_confirmation on our transfer_funds tool so the run pauses for a human, persists the pending request, and resumes after approval or rejection.
Our coordinator keeps sending billing questions to the tech-support sub-agent. Rewrite the sub-agents' descriptions so routing picks the right one.
The delegated Google Drive OAuth access token shows up in the ADK events our UI receives. Keep it in the credential store and out of state and events.
Let our analysts ask the ADK agent questions like 'revenue by region last quarter' that turn into reviewed, read-only BigQuery queries.
Stop our ADK agent spending more than $20 per user per day: refuse new turns once the daily token allowance is used up and tell the user why.
Our ADK assistant should recall a returning user's past orders, stored in BigQuery, scoped to that user and honouring erasure requests.
Our agent reads untrusted web pages and has tools that send email and move money. Work out which tools an injected page could abuse and which ones need a human in the loop.
Anyone can resume another user's ADK chat by posting their session_id to our /run_sse endpoint. Make continuation reject sessions the caller does not own and show an error state in the chat.
Our client's counsel asked for an AI impact assessment and a system card for the claims agent before the production decision.

Our ADK triage agent's instruction has three few-shot examples that all approve, and it now approves too often. Rework the exemplars: how many, which labels, what order, and keep them as data with IDs.
Our ADK agent's eval set is too small to catch regressions. Design new cases for the refund policy edge cases and a rubric for the LLM judge.

We changed the few-shot exemplars in our ADK agent's prompt. Measure on our 40-case labelled development set whether decisions improved, with error categories before and after, and keep the holdout untouched.
Our ADK web app's /api/invoices list route returns every customer's invoices to any signed-in user. Add the owner filter to the query and a test; the agent's tools are not involved.

Our ADK chat sessions run to 200 turns and every request resends the whole history, so latency and token cost climb each turn. Add history trimming or a summariser without breaking function-call pairs, and measure the saving.

Before our ADK agent's issue_refund tool runs on amounts over $500, a finance reviewer must approve it. The request can wait hours and must survive a restart. Implement the approval hold and the reviewer's decision.
When Gemini returns 429 errors, fall back to a second model for our ADK agent and record which model answered each turn.
Which Gemini model and thinking level should our new ADK extraction agent use, given its strict JSON output contract and a tight latency budget?
Users sometimes paste API keys and card numbers into our ADK chat. Detect and mask them before the model, the session history and the logs see them.
Roll the new revision of our already-deployed ADK agent out to 10% of traffic, compare eval scores and error rates, and roll back if they regress.
Connect our ADK agent to the approved GitHub MCP server over streamable HTTP with a tool filter and a name prefix, and close the connection cleanly on shutdown.
Our travel assistant should remember a user's preferred airline and recent trips when they come back next week in a new chat, scoped to that user, and forget them on request.
Our client's DPO wants a DPIA input pack and a records-of-processing entry for the ADK claims agent before the pilot decision.
Add a step where a manager approves any refund over $500 before the agent's refund tool executes; decisions may come the next day.
The ADK agent behind our FastAPI app has a get_orders tool whose user_id comes from the model's arguments, so a crafted message reads someone else's orders. Bind the tool to the verified caller.
Our ADK agent's lookup_invoices tool takes customer_id as a model argument, so a user asked the chat for another customer's invoices and got them. Make the tool act only for the verified caller.
Rewrite the few-shot examples in our ADK classifier's prompt so they are balanced across labels and use the same format as the required output.
Our ADK agent forgets everything when a user starts a new chat session. Make it recall relevant past conversations, scoped per user, with a way to delete them.
Our ADK agent sometimes calls search_flights forty times with the same arguments in one turn. Stop the repetition and cap model calls per invocation.
A payment was approved by a human, then the provider call timed out and our retry created a second payment. Fix the retry so the same approved payment cannot be submitted twice.
Add a GitHub Actions step that runs our existing ADK eval set on every pull request, repeats flaky cases three times, caps the judge spend and fails the build below 90%.
Our ADK agent reads inbound supplier emails and can pay invoices and email customers. Which of its tools should require confirmation, and what could a poisoned email make it do?
Compare our agent's development-set score with the old and the new few-shot exemplars, categorise the remaining errors and report which version wins.
Our released ADK agent's Gemini model retires next quarter. Plan the migration: re-baseline the eval suite on the replacement, pin the new model ID in the release manifest and keep rollback ready.
When our ADK agent's tool is waiting for confirmation, show an approve/reject card in the CopilotKit chat and keep the tool timeline correct after a rejection.
Long ADK sessions get slow because each turn sends the full conversation history to the model. Cut what is sent per turn and show latency before and after.
Design the approve and reject buttons that appear in our chat UI when the agent asks to file a ticket, and how the timeline looks after someone rejects.

After a reviewer approved a refund, our ADK agent's call to the payment provider timed out and the retry refunded the customer twice. Make the approved refund run exactly once and report uncertain outcomes.

In our ADK web app the chat sidebar lists other people's conversations and lets you resume them, because the sessions and run_sse endpoints trust the user_id the browser sends. Fix listing and continuation so only the owner's sessions work.
